entry.title: New generation Chameleons & LEA Products
entry.summary:
New generation Chameleon products are in stock; Pentester packs have been updated; Law Enforcement and Enterprise Tools have been created - and we even made some great stickers.

More
entry.content:
Lab401 in 2020

It's been a busy start to the year at Lab401. The new generation Chameleon products are in stock; all our pentester packs have been updated to the latest generation tools, and we've also launched the Law Enforcement and Enterprise tools.

LEA Products

In order to support the needs to the Law Enforcement and Government Services, Lab401 has opened its LEA Tools section.

We have high performance tools for demanding situations - RF, RFID and Automotive solutions.

Access to LEA products is restricted to verified Law Enforcement bodies, Government Services and their suppliers. For access, please contact customer support from an official email account, or with your credentials, and we will grant access.

We have also opened our Enterprise Tools section, with tools restricted to verifiable enterprise clients in the pentesting industry. Our tools are exclusive to Lab401, highly specialised, and already used in the field and lab for special operations.

As with the LEA Tools, please send an email to Lab401 support to get access to the Enterprise Tools.

Brand New Chameleons

The new generation of Chameleon devices are finally available. The Proxgrind Chameleon devices are the latest evolution of the KAOS RevG devices.

There are two flavours of device: the RevG and the ChameleonTiny.

Product Comparison

There are several ChameleonMini devices available. The table below breaks down the differences in detail.

If your are a penetration tester / researcher, or require wireless functionality, Lab401 recommends the ChameleonMini RevG by Proxgrind.

If you are looking to store all your tags in one device, or size is the most important factor for you, Lab401 recommends the ChameleonTiny.

entry.title: ChameleonMini UI 1.1.0.1 Released!
entry.summary:
Lab401 is excited to present the latest version of its ChameleonMini UI Tool, version 1.1.0.1

With a huge thanks to iceman, who has put in a huge amount of work over the last few months, the Chameleon Mini UI tool is a powerful update on the previous version, and is also open source....

More
entry.content:
Lab401 is excited to present the latest version of its ChameleonMini UI Tool, version 1.1.0.1

With a huge thanks to iceman, who has put in a huge amount of work over the last few months, the Chameleon Mini UI tool is a powerful update on the previous version, and is also open source.

The changelog is as follows:

  • User-friendly dump file management with the option to byte-wise compare two different dump files
  • Color templating of binary files (templates included: Mifare Classic s20, s50, Mifare UL-ev1 164b)
  • Long button press action support
  • Improved GUI layout (drag 'n drop)
  • Multilanguage support (includes english, greek, french, italian, swedish, chinese)

As before, the version supports automagic detection of:

  • Chameleon Mini RevE
  • Chameleon Mini RevE Rebooted
  • Chameleon Mini RevG

The software allows for:

  • Slot management
  • Bulk-actions
  • Uploading / Downloading of dumps
  • mfkey32 aka "reader attack"

The settings tab provides:

  • Keep-Alive functionality
  • RSSI Voltage monitoring
  • Default downloading locations
  • Intelligent Bootloader, Flashing and Default Firmware Restoration functions

Grab a copy of the new software here.

If you enjoy the software, find a bug, or wish to contribute, the source is available on github: https://github.com/iceman1001/ChameleonMini-rebootedGUI

Want to get a Chameleon Mini to get started? We've got them in stock - in our Pen Tester Pack, or as a standalone Chameleon Mini package - get yours shipped today.
